scope: Full Stack Infrastructure & Desktop Client Security Audit (Client + Backend)

remediated_findings.title: Hardcoded fallback API secret token in client binary
remediated_findings.remediation_summary: Completely removed static token proxync_default_secret_2026. Replaced with Option 3: Anonymous Device Identity PKI (Ed25519) + Anti-Replay Timestamp verification + Multi-tiered admin authorization.

remediated_findings.title: Unbounded path traversal in read_file_content IPC handler
remediated_findings.remediation_summary: Added std::fs::canonicalize validation to verify that target paths strictly stay within canonical root directory bounds before reading.

remediated_findings.title: Subdomain CLI flag injection risk in open_native_tunnel
remediated_findings.remediation_summary: Sanitized clean_subdomain with trim_start_matches('-').trim_end_matches('-') on client and validated regex ^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$ on server.

remediated_findings.title: Passing Bearer tokens via CLI arguments to external curl process
remediated_findings.remediation_summary: Eliminated curl.exe subprocess spawning; replaced with native async in-process reqwest::Client.

remediated_findings.title: Permissive Windows ACL fallback to Everyone in icacls grant
remediated_findings.remediation_summary: Removed Everyone fallback in icacls grant. Keys are strictly restricted to inheritance:r and granted only to the current logged-in %USERNAME%.

remediated_findings.title: Concurrent device subdomain overwrite risk on backend JIT API
remediated_findings.remediation_summary: Bound activeSubdomains to devicePublicKey on the backend server. Rejects conflicting registration attempts from different devices with 409 Conflict while a session is active.

remaining_operational_notes.title: Unredacted Request Body Inspector Preview
remaining_operational_notes.notes: start_proxy captures raw request bodies for developer inspection in the Studio UI while strictly redacting Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, and API-Key headers.

remaining_operational_notes.title: Major-version pinned GitHub Actions in CI workflows
remaining_operational_notes.notes: Workflows pin actions to official major versions (e.g. actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4) under manual dispatch and push triggers.
